name: View-Dependent Adaptive Refinement
definition: A technique to display large-volume data at interactive frame rates by adaptively refining meshes in regions of interest (close to viewpoint/line of sight) while using lower resolution for distant regions, based on an approximation error E(T) and a distance-dependent threshold.
summary: View-Dependent Adaptive Refinement renders large volumes interactively by continuously adjusting mesh resolution based on viewer distance and error thresholds, unlike discrete LOD methods.
